message.content: {"question":"The gravitational potential V(r) of a homogeneous spherical mass M of radius R, at a point where r > R, is equal to: (here r is the distance from the center of the sphere)","options":{"A":"V(r) = -γM/r²","B":"V(r) = -γMR/r²","C":"V(r) = -γM/r","D":"V(r) = -γM/R²"},"correct":"C"}
